ctx.x: What was the first music you remember hearing? Did your father and mother play any instruments?

My father and mother played music together and my sister and my little brother too. He was named Herman Love. Herman Love. Herman, Mary and Nettie. What did your father play? My father played cornet. My mother played the cellar bass. He played what? Cellar bass. Bass? Cellar bass. Cellar bass. Cellar bass. What did they call it? Cellar bass.
Oh the cello you mean? Yeah cellar. The one where you sit down and play? Yeah.
